statement: ∀ N : ℕ, 2≤N → (∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico 2 N, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (t-1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2))/((t:ℝ)*(t+1))) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N-1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2) * ((n+2:ℝ)⁻¹-(N:ℝ)⁻¹)

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Identify the Abel endpoint weight for gap two

brief.zh: 对每个整数 $N\ge2$，令 $\Delta_t=F_t(3)-2F_t(2)+F_t(1)$，证明 $\tfrac12\sum_{t=2}^{N-1}\Delta_t/(t(t+1))=\sum_{n+2\le N}\Lambda(n)\Lambda(n+2)(1/(n+2)-1/N)$。使用 `second-difference` 后先按 $n$ 求和，$n+2=N$ 处系数恰为零。
brief.en: Expand the nonnegative finite prefix and sum the reciprocal differences by telescoping.
